properties.name: Built work is linked for the owner's word, and fourteen reading-only ideas are rejected on his ruling
properties.rationale:
THE OWNER'S WORD. Anthony, 2026-10-13, on items 17-25 of the judgement pass: "Go with your recommendations." Recorded on chg:the-owner-rules-on-items-17-to-25-of-the-judgement-pass-2026-10-13, whose summary lists as "Accepted and recorded when they are carried out": "built-but-open work: draw the missing links before he rules"; "undelivered accepted requirements: link those already built, then keep, defer or drop against the few-jobs yardstick"; and "the proposed rejections of reading-only ideas". It also records "an advisory rule that an idea from reading waits for a real use".

WHAT WAS DONE, PER PART.
(A) 63 links. 59 EVOLVES_INTO from 44 ideas the judgement pass proposed to accept as built or promoted, each to the capability that built it (or, for a promotion, the accepted requirement it became), the ship-step link the served instructions name since reflow2 #745; and 4 SATISFIES (cap:select-graph-by-id to req:a-session-cannot-address-another-design; cap:feedback-is-a-computed-tally to req:reflow2-can-say-which-of-its-own-skills-a-session-reached-for and to req:telemetry-carries-usage-never-design-content; cap:release-publishes-a-container to req:the-isolation-proof-runs-against-the-image-that-ships). Each edge's evidence names the capability, a passing check or the realizing file, and the change where one shipped it. Two of the 44 ideas will not surface for his word: dec:idea-a-hub-owns-designs-it-does-not-absorb-and-that-is-a-third-relation is parked by an accepted ruling, and dec:idea-should-optimize-be-a-served-skill-any-project-can-run points at a capability whose record still reads planned. Ten more were already linked and already listed. Fourteen rows were not linked because no capability clearly names what built them; they are listed in the design PR for his ruling rather than guessed.
(B) 1 link. Of 57 accepted requirements with nothing satisfying them (48 when measured on 2026-10-13), the name match suggested about a quarter were built under another name; read against their statements, only one is delivered whole. About eleven are partly built (for example a conditional write exists on create_node only, quantity provenance exists for constraints but not decisions, claim liveness exists without a doing-state); no partial link was drawn, because a partial SATISFIES would hide the requirement from the unsatisfied list he is about to rule on.
(C) 14 rejections, each re-read first and found unchanged since 2026-10-13, with no capability, requirement or use linked. The other proposed rejections (62 still proposed, not from reading, among them the 2026-08-31 self-absorption cluster) are not covered by this ruling and wait for Phase 3; three others were already rejected by his items 5 and 6.

NO OTHER STATUS MOVED and no approver was set except on the fourteen rejections. Detected gaps rose (220 to 260 open) because decision_overtaken_by_promotion now puts the newly linked ideas to him, which is what the links are for.

Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq

properties.summary: Carrying out three of the owner's 2026-10-13 rulings on the judgement pass, design record only. (A) Built-but-open work: 59 EVOLVES_INTO links from 44 open ideas to the capabilities (or accepted requirements) that built them, and 4 SATISFIES links from capabilities to proposed requirements they already deliver; no status moved. (B) Item 25, pass 1: 1 SATISFIES link to an accepted requirement built under another name (req:the-contract-ships-with-the-artifact-and-is-readable-from-a-session); the other accepted-but-unsatisfied requirements wait for his keep, defer or drop. (C) Fourteen ideas that came from reading (LangChain/LangSmith, PEP-1 and the NumPy NEPs twice, game theory, knot theory, CAP/PACELC twice, OpenMBEE DocGen, an arXiv paper, a Cisco blog post, and four from the dynograph-foundation review) and saw no real use since are rejected, with him as approver, acted 2026-10-13. loop_status scoped to who:ajs: awaiting_word went from 51 (38 delivered requirements, 13 promoted ideas) to 97 (42 and 55).
